description: This source file implements the core logic of the 'send-pack' command in Git, handling the transmission of objects, refs, and push negotiations between repository clients and servers. It includes functions for packing objects, negotiating refs, generating push certificates, and managing communication protocols.

methods.name: int option_parse_push_signed(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Parses the command-line argument for push signing options and sets the corresponding configuration.

methods.name: void feed_object(struct repository * r,const struct object_id * oid,FILE * fh,int negative)
methods.description: Feeds an object ID into the pack-objects process, optionally marking it as negative.

methods.name: int pack_objects(struct repository * r,int fd,struct ref * refs,struct oid_array * advertised,struct oid_array * negotiated,struct send_pack_args * args)
methods.description: Creates a pack stream of objects and writes it to the provided file descriptor, handling object batching and transmission.

methods.name: int receive_unpack_status(struct packet_reader * reader)
methods.description: Reads and verifies the status of the remote unpack operation.

methods.name: int receive_status(struct repository * r,struct packet_reader * reader,struct ref * refs)
methods.description: Reads and processes the status report from the remote after push, updating refs accordingly.

methods.name: int sideband_demux(int in UNUSED,int out,void * data)
methods.description: Demultiplexes sideband streams during data transfer.

methods.name: int advertise_shallow_grafts_cb(const struct commit_graft * graft,void * cb)
methods.description: Callback for advertising shallow grafts when pushing shallow clones.

methods.name: void advertise_shallow_grafts_buf(struct repository * r,struct strbuf * sb)
methods.description: Prepares the buffer with shallow graft information.

methods.name: int check_to_send_update(const struct ref * ref,const struct send_pack_args * args)
methods.description: Determines if a particular ref should be sent based on its status and push options.

methods.name: const char * next_line(const char * line,size_t len)
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the next line in a buffer, or the end if incomplete.

methods.name: int generate_push_cert(struct strbuf * req_buf,const struct ref * remote_refs,struct send_pack_args * args,const char * cap_string,const char * push_cert_nonce)
methods.description: Generates a signed push certificate for authorized refs.

methods.name: void reject_invalid_nonce(const char * nonce,int len)
methods.description: Validates the nonce used in push certification, rejecting invalid characters.

methods.name: void get_commons_through_negotiation(struct repository * r,const char * url,const struct ref * remote_refs,struct oid_array * commons)
methods.description: Negotiates object common ancestors with the remote to optimize pushing.

methods.name: int send_pack(struct repository * r,struct send_pack_args * args,int fd[],struct child_process * conn,struct ref * remote_refs,struct oid_array * extra_have)
methods.description: Main function to handle package sending logic, including negotiating refs, packing objects, and data transfer protocols.
